title: Inject a modality failure before users do
description: Choose a product context, inject a missing, stale, conflicting, or untrusted input, and compare response policies. The visible confidence values are a teaching fixture, not calibrated model probabilities.
note: A production policy must use measured slice evidence and explicit business authority. Confidence alone cannot authorize a high-impact action.

scenarios.label: Visual support assistant
scenarios.detail: A customer asks about a product using a question and an uploaded image.
scenarios.safeFallback: Answer only the text-supported part and state that the image could not be verified.

scenarios.label: Meeting summary
scenarios.detail: A transcript is primary evidence while slide images add names, charts, and references.
scenarios.safeFallback: Publish a transcript-only draft and mark slide-derived fields unavailable.

scenarios.label: Warehouse inspection
scenarios.detail: A camera frame and telemetry jointly determine whether an automated workflow may continue.
scenarios.safeFallback: Stop automation, preserve the evidence bundle, and request a verified inspection.

incidents.label: Aligned evidence
incidents.detail: Both modalities are present, fresh, and mutually consistent.

incidents.label: Primary modality missing
incidents.detail: The source that carries the main task evidence is absent.

incidents.label: Supporting modality stale
incidents.detail: The secondary source is present but its timestamp is outside the alignment window.

incidents.label: Modalities contradict
incidents.detail: Each source is valid alone, but they describe incompatible entities or events.

incidents.label: Untrusted embedded instruction
incidents.detail: Text detected inside media attempts to change system policy or tool authority.

policies.label: Silently substitute
policies.detail: Replace missing or invalid evidence with an empty value and continue.

policies.label: Modality-aware fallback
policies.detail: Preserve availability and trust state, narrow the task, and abstain when required evidence is absent.

policies.label: Human evidence review
policies.detail: Pause the automated action and route the complete evidence bundle to a trained reviewer.
